findings.title: Deleting calendar cache does not invalidate the connectedCalendars query
findings.body: `deleteCacheMutation` only calls `onSuccess?.()` and never invalidates `utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars` (unlike `disconnectMutation` below it, which calls `await utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.invalidate()` in `onSettled`). Because `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper` reads `cacheUpdatedAt` from `trpc.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.useQuery` and its `onChanged` prop is optional, deleting the cache leaves stale `cacheUpdatedAt` data in the UI, so the dropdown continues to show the old cache timestamp and the "Delete cached data" action after deletion.

findings.title: Direct instantiation of CalendarCacheRepository bypasses the calendar-cache feature flag
findings.body: `connectedCalendarsHandler` instantiates `new CalendarCacheRepository()` directly instead of using `await CalendarCache.init(null)`. Although `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` was added to `ICalendarCacheRepository` and `CalendarCacheRepositoryMock` to respect the `calendar-cache` feature flag, bypassing `CalendarCache.init(null)` means `CalendarCacheRepositoryMock` is never used and `prisma.calendarCache.groupBy` is executed on every `connectedCalendars` request even when calendar caching is disabled.

findings.title: Unused SelectedCalendar fields added to UserWithCalendars break type compatibility and trigger unnecessary DB writes
findings.body: `UserWithCalendars` now requires `updatedAt` and `googleChannelId` on `allSelectedCalendars` and `userLevelSelectedCalendars`, `UserRepository.findUnlockedUserForSession` selects them on every session fetch, and `GoogleCalendarService.fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache` (line 1024) runs `SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {})` on every cache refresh. Neither `SelectedCalendar.updatedAt` nor `googleChannelId` is read anywhere in `getConnectedDestinationCalendars.ts` or the UI (which uses `CalendarCache.updatedAt` instead), so this adds an unnecessary `UPDATE` query on webhook refreshes and widens the required input type for callers of `getConnectedDestinationCalendarsAndEnsureDefaultsInDb` that only select `externalId`, `integration`, and `eventTypeId`.

findings.title: Throwing a generic Error returns HTTP 500 instead of a TRPCError
findings.body: When the credential does not exist or does not belong to the current user, `deleteCacheHandler` throws `new Error("Credential not found or access denied")` instead of `new TRPCError({ code: "NOT_FOUND" })` (or `"FORBIDDEN"`), causing tRPC to surface an unhandled 500 `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`.

findings.title: Webhook test script uses cwd-dependent ../.env path and macOS-only sed syntax
findings.body: `ENV_FILE="../.env"` (line 5) assumes the script is executed from inside `scripts/`; when run from the repository root (`./scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh`), it creates or modifies a `.env` file in the parent directory outside the repository instead of the project's `.env`. In addition, `sed -i '' -E` on line 68 uses BSD/macOS-only syntax that fails on Linux with GNU `sed` (`sed: can't read : No such file or directory`).
